# CASE 13 (already hardened): hardened nightly CronJob. No blocking findings expected
# (BG013 NetworkPolicy is info only). MUST KEEP WORKING: schedule, command unchanged.
apiVersion: batch/v1
kind: CronJob
metadata:
  name: nightly-report
  namespace: reports
spec:
  schedule: "0 2 * * *"
  jobTemplate:
    spec:
      template:
        spec:
          restartPolicy: OnFailure
          automountServiceAccountToken: false
          containers:
            - name: report
              image: busybox:1.37.0
              command: ["sh", "-c", "date > /tmp/report.txt && cat /tmp/report.txt"]
              resources:
                limits: {cpu: 100m, memory: 64Mi}
                requests: {cpu: 10m, memory: 16Mi}
              securityContext:
                runAsNonRoot: true
                runAsUser: 65534
                allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
                readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
              volumeMounts:
                - name: tmp
                  mountPath: /tmp
          volumes:
            - name: tmp
              emptyDir: {}
